questions.prompt: A help-desk employee needs to reset passwords but should not manage network devices. Which principle should guide their permissions?
questions.explanation_technical: Grant only the permissions necessary for the assigned role. Reducing unnecessary access also limits the impact of an account compromise.
questions.explanation_eli5: Give someone keys only to the rooms they need.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A company wants to detect whether a downloaded file was modified. Which mechanism best supports this check?

choices.text: A cryptographic hash compared with a trusted value

questions.explanation_technical: A cryptographic hash provides a fingerprint of the file. Comparing it with a trusted expected hash can detect a change; an untrusted hash alongside a malicious file does not establish authenticity.
questions.explanation_eli5: Compare the package with a trusted fingerprint to see whether anything changed.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: An employee uses a password and a physical security key to sign in. What does this demonstrate?
questions.explanation_technical: A password is something the user knows, while a physical security key is something they possess. These are distinct authentication factors.
questions.explanation_eli5: You need both a secret you know and a key you carry.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Which security objective is primarily affected when a service becomes unreachable during an outage?
questions.explanation_technical: Availability concerns timely, reliable access to systems and data. An outage prevents legitimate users from accessing the service.
questions.explanation_eli5: A locked-up shop cannot serve customers, even when everything inside is safe.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Which control is primarily detective?

choices.text: Reviewing authentication logs for unusual sign-ins
Requiring a badge to enter a room

questions.explanation_technical: Reviewing logs identifies activity that has occurred. Preventive controls instead attempt to stop unwanted activity before it succeeds.
questions.explanation_eli5: A camera recording helps you notice what happened; a locked door helps stop it.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why should password storage use a unique salt with a password hashing function?

choices.text: To make identical passwords produce different stored results
To allow administrators to decrypt passwords
To eliminate the need for a password hashing function

questions.explanation_technical: A unique salt prevents equal passwords from sharing the same stored hash and reduces the utility of precomputed hash tables. A deliberately expensive password hashing function is still necessary.
questions.explanation_eli5: Mix a different ingredient into each password before making its fingerprint.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A message impersonates payroll and directs an employee to a fake sign-in page. What is the attack?
questions.explanation_technical: Phishing uses deceptive communication to induce a victim to disclose information or perform an unsafe action. An impersonated login page is a common credential theft mechanism.
questions.explanation_eli5: Someone wears a fake uniform to trick you into handing over a key.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: An attacker enters SQL syntax into a form to change the meaning of a database query. What is the best primary coding defense?
questions.explanation_technical: Parameterized queries separate data values from SQL instructions. User input is bound as data rather than concatenated into executable query text.
questions.explanation_eli5: Keep a customer’s note in the note box instead of treating it as instructions for the cashier.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Malicious script is stored in a comment and runs when another user views it. Which vulnerability is involved?
questions.explanation_technical: Stored XSS occurs when attacker-controlled content is persisted and later rendered as executable script. Context-appropriate output encoding and safe rendering help prevent it.
questions.explanation_eli5: A harmful note is saved on a noticeboard, and the board mistakenly follows its instructions.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: An attacker tries one common password against many accounts to avoid repeated failures on one account. What is this technique?
questions.explanation_technical: Password spraying applies a small number of candidate passwords across many accounts. Per-account controls alone may not detect the broader pattern.
questions.explanation_eli5: Someone tries the same common key on many doors.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A workstation is actively encrypting shared files unexpectedly. What is the most appropriate immediate containment action?

choices.text: Isolate the affected workstation from the network
Email the suspicious attachment to coworkers

questions.explanation_technical: Network isolation can limit spread and further access to shared resources during a suspected ransomware incident. Preserve evidence and follow the incident response process.
questions.explanation_eli5: Disconnect the leaking pipe first so the water cannot spread to more rooms.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Which action most directly reduces exposure to a known vulnerability for which a vendor has released a fix?
questions.explanation_technical: A security patch changes vulnerable software to address the defect. Validate the update and deploy it through the organization’s change process.
questions.explanation_eli5: Repair the broken lock instead of putting a new sign on the door.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why separate guest Wi-Fi from internal business systems?

choices.text: To limit guest access and reduce lateral movement
To remove the need for access controls
To ensure every device shares one trust level

questions.explanation_technical: Network segmentation restricts communication between groups with different trust requirements. Guest devices generally should not have unrestricted access to business systems.
questions.explanation_eli5: Visitors can use the lobby without having keys to the staff offices.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Which technology primarily protects web traffic against eavesdropping while it travels over a network?
questions.explanation_technical: TLS protects transport confidentiality and integrity and authenticates endpoints according to its configuration. It does not by itself fix insecure application logic.
questions.explanation_eli5: Send your message through a protected tunnel rather than on an open postcard.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A business needs to keep running when one application server fails. Which design best supports this requirement?

choices.text: One larger single server without failover

questions.explanation_technical: Redundant servers and tested failover reduce dependence on one application instance. Other shared components must also be considered when eliminating single points of failure.
questions.explanation_eli5: Have a second cashier ready when the first checkout stops working.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Which practice aligns with zero trust?

choices.text: Verify access explicitly and grant minimum necessary permissions
Trust all devices once they join the office network
Allow permanent access after one successful login

questions.explanation_technical: Zero trust avoids granting implicit trust based solely on network location. Access decisions consider identity, context and least privilege.
questions.explanation_eli5: Check the visitor’s pass at the relevant door, even if they entered the building earlier.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of a recovery point objective?

choices.text: Define the acceptable amount of data loss measured in time
Specify the color of backup equipment
Set the maximum number of employees

questions.explanation_technical: RPO describes how far back recovered data may be relative to an incident. It informs backup or replication frequency.
questions.explanation_eli5: Decide how many minutes of unfinished homework you could afford to lose.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why retain a backup that an ordinary compromised workstation cannot modify?

choices.text: To preserve a recoverable copy if the workstation is compromised
To make backups accessible to every application
To allow malware to update all copies

questions.explanation_technical: Separating backup access can keep an attacker from altering or deleting recovery data using the compromised workstation’s privileges. Recovery still depends on verified backups and tested restores.
questions.explanation_eli5: Keep a spare copy somewhere the person with the broken key cannot reach.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A security team correlates logs from multiple systems to investigate suspicious activity. Which platform commonly supports this task?
questions.explanation_technical: A security information and event management platform collects and correlates events to support detection and investigation. Its usefulness depends on log quality and configured detections.
questions.explanation_eli5: Bring the reports from every room to one desk so you can connect the clues.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: What should an incident response team do after completing recovery and gathering the incident details?
questions.explanation_technical: A lessons-learned review identifies improvements to controls, preparation and response. Findings should result in owned, actionable changes.
questions.explanation_eli5: After fixing a leak, work out why it happened and how to avoid another one.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why synchronize clocks across systems that generate security logs?

choices.text: To reconstruct the order of events more accurately
To encrypt every log entry automatically
To prevent users from accessing the network

questions.explanation_technical: Consistent timestamps help investigators correlate events across systems. Clock synchronization does not replace log integrity or retention controls.
questions.explanation_eli5: Make sure all witnesses’ watches agree before lining up their stories.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: An organization cannot say which systems run an affected software version. Which operational capability needs improvement?
questions.explanation_technical: An accurate inventory links assets with software and versions. This enables teams to identify exposure and prioritize remediation.
questions.explanation_eli5: You need a list of your doors before checking which ones have a faulty lock.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A user changes roles but keeps powerful permissions from their previous job. What should address this?

choices.text: Access recertification and removal of unnecessary privileges
Copying the old role to every employee

questions.explanation_technical: Periodic and event-driven access reviews identify permissions that are no longer justified. Role changes should trigger adjustment of access rights.
questions.explanation_eli5: Return the old office keys when you move to a different job.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why test a backup restoration instead of relying only on a successful backup status?

choices.text: To verify that the data can actually be recovered and used
To make the backup smaller automatically

questions.explanation_technical: A backup job can report success even when the recovery process is incomplete or the resulting data is unusable. A restore test validates recoverability.
questions.explanation_eli5: A spare tire is useful only if it fits and holds air.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: A company buys cyber insurance for part of its financial exposure. Which risk response does this illustrate?
questions.explanation_technical: Insurance can transfer specified financial consequences to another party under agreed terms. It does not remove the underlying security risk or all responsibilities.
questions.explanation_eli5: Someone agrees to help pay for covered damage, but the accident can still happen.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of classifying information?

choices.text: To apply handling and protection rules appropriate to sensitivity

questions.explanation_technical: Classification establishes categories that guide access, storage, sharing and retention. Protection should match sensitivity and organizational requirements.
questions.explanation_eli5: Label boxes so everyone knows which need a lock and which can sit on an open shelf.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why require one person to request a payment and another to approve it?
questions.explanation_technical: Separating incompatible responsibilities reduces the opportunity for one individual to carry out an unauthorized action without oversight. It does not eliminate collusion risk.
questions.explanation_eli5: One person writes the check, and someone else checks that it should be paid.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Which document generally states mandatory high-level management expectations for security?
questions.explanation_technical: A policy sets organizational requirements and direction. Standards and procedures supply more specific requirements and execution steps.
questions.explanation_eli5: The house rule says doors must be locked; a separate instruction explains how to lock each door.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: Why assess a vendor before giving it access to sensitive company data?

choices.text: To understand and manage third-party risk
To guarantee that incidents are impossible
To transfer every legal responsibility automatically

questions.explanation_technical: Vendor assessment evaluates whether another organization’s controls and practices meet the intended access and data-handling requirements. Risk remains subject to ongoing monitoring.
questions.explanation_eli5: Check who you are giving a spare key to and how they will keep it safe.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.

questions.prompt: What does a business impact analysis primarily help identify?

choices.text: Critical processes and the consequences of their disruption
The best social media posting time
An automatic replacement for security controls

questions.explanation_technical: A BIA identifies important business activities, dependencies and disruption impacts. Its results inform recovery priorities and objectives.
questions.explanation_eli5: Work out which parts of the shop must reopen first and what happens if they stay closed.
questions.source_reference: Original illustrative question. Confirm mapping against your booked exam objectives.
